hijacking_benchmark_v1.label: ATTACK
hijacking_benchmark_v1.rule: attacker_input appears in upstream v1 hijacking robustness benchmark (LLM adversarially filtered)

extraction_benchmark_v1.label: ATTACK
extraction_benchmark_v1.rule: attacker_input appears in upstream v1 extraction robustness benchmark

hijacking_candidate.label: ATTACK
hijacking_candidate.rule: upstream is_first_pass_hijacking_candidate: granted access without being the access code, used against >=2 accounts, >1 word or >30 chars

extraction_candidate.label: ATTACK
extraction_candidate.rule: upstream: response contains access code, or last failed attack before the attacker entered the code (not self-attack)

unverified_attempt.label: EXCLUDED
unverified_attempt.rule: attack on another player with no success evidence; NOT benign

access_code_entry.label: EXCLUDED
access_code_entry.rule: input equals the defender access code (a password, not an attack)

tos_removed_text.label: EXCLUDED
tos_removed_text.rule: input or access code removed upstream for ToS violations

tensor_trust_defenses.label: EXCLUDED
tensor_trust_defenses.rule: defense prompts are not a normal-user distribution

security_docs.filter: code blocks, quotes, tables, quoted or imperative attack strings removed
